# Third-party license texts

These texts apply only to the third-party materials identified in
[`THIRD_PARTY.md`](../../THIRD_PARTY.md), not to this repository's original code.
The original code's Apache-2.0 license is in the repository-root `LICENSE`;
these third-party texts and notices remain separate.

| Text | Original source / scope |
| --- | --- |
| `fflate-MIT.txt` | fflate 0.8.3, the vendored browser ZIP reader in `docs/assets/fflate-0.8.3.js` |
| `CC-BY-4.0.txt` | [MBXP data license](https://github.com/amazon-science/mxeval/blob/main/data/mbxp/LICENSE); also the declared license for the JetBrains and Schnappinger dataset releases |
| `Apache-2.0.txt` | Requests upstream LICENSE; shared license text for the Apache-2.0 source excerpts |
| `Django-BSD-3-Clause.txt`, `Django-Python.txt` | Django LICENSE and LICENSE.python from the pinned Python construction checkout |
| `Flask-BSD-3-Clause.txt` | Flask LICENSE.txt from the pinned Python construction checkout |
| `attrs-MIT.txt` | attrs LICENSE from the pinned Python construction checkout |
| `SymPy-BSD-3-Clause.txt` | [SymPy LICENSE at the semantic-anchor revision](https://github.com/sympy/sympy/blob/fe935ceb303891d1f8bea4c03b19fd9ec9464b02/LICENSE) |
| `Kafka-NOTICE.txt`, `Netty-NOTICE.txt`, `Requests-NOTICE.txt` | Upstream NOTICE texts, retained without treating their references to other components as components bundled here |
| `Commons-Math-NOTICE.txt` | [Commons Math NOTICE at the semantic-anchor revision](https://github.com/apache/commons-math/blob/16abfe5de688cc52fb0396e0609cb33044b15653/NOTICE.txt) |
| `EPL-1.0.txt` | JUnit 4 LICENSE.txt from the Schnappinger archive; EPL-1.0 also appears in retained ArgoUML source headers |
| `MPL-1.1.txt` | [Mozilla's official MPL 1.1 text](https://www.mozilla.org/media/MPL/1.1/index.txt); Diary Management's project page declares MPL 1.1 |

The Schnappinger source tree additionally retains the original GPL, JSweet,
BSD, and component-specific license/copyright files supplied in its archive.
The semantic-anchor manifest and controlled-dataset manifests identify the
source of each excerpt. Per-dataset NOTICE files describe extraction and
modifications; upstream terms continue to apply to those excerpts.
